sections.title: The letter efe
paragraphs: The name of the letter is (efe) /ˈefe/. It has one sound. You hear it in (fuego) /ˈfwe.ɣo/, which means fire.

sections.title: How to say efe
paragraphs: Rest your top teeth gently on your bottom lip. Push air through the small gap between them. Do not use your voice. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake.

sections.title: Spelling and sounds
paragraphs: The letter always makes this sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of a word in (fuego) /ˈfwe.ɣo/. You also hear it in the middle of a word in (café) /kaˈfe/.

sections.title: Comparing with English
paragraphs: This sound is just like the sound of the letter f in the English word fire. Keep your top teeth lightly on your lower lip. There is no real pitfall with this sound.
